title: After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup: The Way of Magic

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Sweep Tosho comes in first! The sheer power in that performance was absolutely overwhelming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …Ugh. I lost.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm so saaaad!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And I was really going for the win! Sniffle… Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Pffft. Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Then let's just race again… and again and again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Because as long as we keep challenging each other—as long as we keep moving forward—our path will never end!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heh… That sounds good to me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That way, we can fill the world with even more excitement!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then, the excitement will keep building and building—all the way into the future!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …I kinda like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Me too…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Okay, I've made up my mind. Let's go home, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Already? They haven't even done any interviews yet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't need to see those. If the people who came before us are forging a future, we have to get serious! We'll forge the future beyond theirs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Because I'm going to be the ultimate number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha! Geez, you're such a handful…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait up! I'm gonna pave my own path before you do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No way I'm just gonna sit around while everyone else hits the big time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Everyone's got so much energy! ♪ Well, guess it's time for me to scoot too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not trying to cast any magic, though—I'm gonna make some miracles happen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sweep! Which race are you running in next?! I'm going to run too, so hurry up and tell me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Please! Be! Quiet! Just gimme a chance to rest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! I couldn't possibly! I'm ready now! The spirit of vengeance burns within me at this very moment!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, Kawakami! You're acting just as spoiled as Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! You too, Familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the little witch continues happily along the path she and her apprentices are forging.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel sure that she'll cast some new magic on the world someday. And when she does, it'll be alongside a new generation of Umamusume.
